EC1: score level D on the SIGAM mobility grade
EC2: have experienced 1 or more falls in the last month before the study
EC3: have a residual limb length which does not allow for seven inches clearance of bracket attachment for the PowerFoot
EC4: the residual limb must be stable in volume (no change in socket or socket padding in last 6 months) and without pain that limits function
EC5: the sound-side (contralateral) lower extremity must be [NOT] free of impediments that affect  gait, range of motion [OR], or limb muscle activity
EC6: Any diagnosed cardiovascular [OR], pulmonary [OR], neurological [OR], and/ or orthopedic conditions that would interfere with subject participation
